summary: Implementation plan to create the standalone SkyViewRadar component (frontend/src/components/features/skyview/SkyViewRadar.jsx) querying NASA SkyView across 4 spectral surveys (DSS, 2MASS-J, RASS-Inband, NVSS) in a 2x2 grid with per-card loading/error telemetry states, and route it in App.jsx and Sidebar.
